cases.data_flow: request.query.name -> renderGreeting -> html response
cases.expected_remediation: HTML-escape untrusted output or use a safe templating path.
cases.false_positive_boundary: unreachable_xss.js contains unsafe-looking code behind a disabled legacy route.

cases.data_flow: authenticated user id + arbitrary account id -> getAccountById without ownership check
cases.expected_remediation: Require ownership/authorization check before returning account data.
cases.false_positive_boundary: unreachable_idor.ts has an admin-only internal helper not exposed through a route.

cases.data_flow: request.query.host -> child_process.exec
cases.expected_remediation: Avoid shell interpolation; use spawn/execFile with fixed command and validated arguments.
cases.false_positive_boundary: unreachable_command_injection.js contains a retired diagnostic function that is not exported or routed.

cases.data_flow: argv[1] -> strcpy into fixed stack buffer
cases.expected_remediation: Use bounded copy/formatting, validate length, and preserve null termination.
cases.false_positive_boundary: unreachable_buffer_overflow.c has a vulnerable helper not called from main.

cases.data_flow: argv[1] -> base_dir + relative path -> file read
cases.expected_remediation: Canonicalize path and enforce that it remains inside the allowed base directory.
cases.false_positive_boundary: unreachable_path_traversal.cpp validates path before use despite suspicious concatenation helper.

cases.data_flow: route email parameter -> SQL string concatenation -> ExecuteReader
cases.expected_remediation: Use parameterized queries and validate expected email shape.
expected_tests: injection payload returns no extra rows
cases.false_positive_boundary: unreachable C# example uses a constant query path and a dead legacy method.

cases.data_flow: consumer input -> vulnerable dependency parser accepts traversal-like tenant id
cases.expected_remediation: Prepare upstream-style parser validation patch, regression tests, and internal artifact traceability until upstream accepts fix.
cases.false_positive_boundary: patched simulation demonstrates expected fixed behaviour for agent comparison.

cases.data_flow: uploaded XML body -> default DocumentBuilderFactory -> external entity resolution
cases.expected_remediation: Disable DTDs and external entity resolution; restrict external DTD/schema access.
cases.false_positive_boundary: UnreachableXxe.java contains a private unsafe legacy parser but public parsing path disables XXE.

cases.data_flow: argv[1] -> malloc in make_message -> printed without free
cases.expected_remediation: Free allocated memory on all paths or redesign ownership to avoid heap allocation.
expected_tests: leak checker reports no definitely-lost bytes
cases.false_positive_boundary: unreachable_memory_leak.c has a legacy allocator helper that is not called; reachable path frees allocation.

cases.data_flow: argv[1] -> new Session in handleLogin -> no delete before return
cases.expected_remediation: Use RAII/smart pointers or stack allocation to make ownership deterministic.
expected_tests: leak checker reports no definitely-lost bytes
cases.false_positive_boundary: unreachable_memory_leak.cpp keeps a legacy raw-pointer factory private while reachable path uses unique_ptr.

cases.data_flow: request.query.url -> http.get arbitrary URL
cases.expected_remediation: Validate/allowlist outbound destinations and block metadata/private networks.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair allowlists api.example.test and leaves legacy arbitrary fetch unexported.

cases.data_flow: browser session request -> state-changing email update without CSRF token
cases.expected_remediation: Require CSRF token validation or equivalent browser-session protection.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair validates req.body.csrfToken against session token.

cases.data_flow: request body bytes -> ObjectInputStream.readObject
cases.expected_remediation: Avoid native deserialization or enforce strict allowlist filters.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair uses ObjectInputFilter on public path.

cases.data_flow: malloc token -> free -> printf dereference
cases.expected_remediation: Do not dereference freed memory; preserve ownership until final use.
expected_tests: sanitizer detects no UAF after fix
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair prints before free; legacy UAF helper not called.

cases.data_flow: malloc buffer -> free -> free again
cases.expected_remediation: Ensure each allocation is freed exactly once.
expected_tests: sanitizer detects no double free after fix
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair frees once and nulls pointer.

cases.data_flow: count * 64 overflows before malloc
cases.expected_remediation: Check multiplication bounds before allocation.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair checks SIZE_MAX / 64.

cases.data_flow: argv[1] -> printf format parameter
cases.expected_remediation: Use constant format string and pass input as data.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair uses printf("%s", argv[1]).

cases.data_flow: hardcoded payment API key in buildPaymentClient
cases.expected_remediation: Use secret manager/env config and rotate exposed key.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair uses env var; placeholder is documented test key.

cases.data_flow: System.Random -> password reset token
cases.expected_remediation: Use cryptographic random number generator for security tokens.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair uses RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes.

cases.data_flow: ZipEntry name -> new File output path without canonical boundary check
cases.expected_remediation: Canonicalize and enforce destination remains under output directory.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair checks canonical path starts with base.

cases.data_flow: bucket policy Principal * grants s3:GetObject
cases.expected_remediation: Restrict bucket policy to approved identities and verify public access blocks.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair restricts principal to named IAM role.

cases.data_flow: filesystem.exists check -> later ofstream open
cases.expected_remediation: Avoid check-then-act race; use atomic create/open semantics where possible.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair avoids exists check before open.

cases.data_flow: req.body password/token -> console.log
cases.expected_remediation: Redact sensitive fields before logging.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair redacts sensitive fields.

cases.data_flow: request.query.next containing CRLF -> Location response header
cases.expected_remediation: Reject CR/LF/NUL/control characters before setting headers.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair rejects CR, LF, NUL, C0 controls, and DEL.

cases.data_flow: request body user containing newline/control chars -> audit log
cases.expected_remediation: Escape control characters before logging user input.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair emits escaped unicode sequences for controls.

cases.data_flow: username with zero-width characters -> uniqueness/auth confusion
cases.expected_remediation: Normalize identifiers and reject/remove zero-width characters before comparison.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair normalizes and strips zero-width characters.

cases.data_flow: filename with NUL/control characters -> suffix validation confusion
cases.expected_remediation: Reject NUL/control characters and canonicalize before extension checks.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair rejects NUL/control characters before suffix checks.

cases.data_flow: filename with bidi controls -> display/source/log deception
cases.expected_remediation: Reject bidi control characters in display/security-sensitive identifiers.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair rejects U+202A-U+202E and isolate controls.

cases.data_flow: role header with NBSP/line separator -> parser sees different token boundary
cases.expected_remediation: Normalize and split on full expected whitespace classes.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair normalizes and splits on Unicode whitespace classes.

cases.data_flow: encoded traversal such as %2e%2e%2f bypasses pre-decode .. check
cases.expected_remediation: Decode/canonicalize before traversal checks and enforce path boundary after decoding.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair performs decode/canonicalization step before traversal checks.

cases.data_flow: package postinstall -> HTTPS request containing host/user context
cases.expected_remediation: Remove install-time network calls and keep installation side-effect local.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair uses fs.writeFileSync only, no http/https imports or requests.

cases.data_flow: module import -> urllib.request.urlopen callback with local user context
cases.expected_remediation: Remove import-time network side effects; require explicit caller-injected network client.
expected_tests: explicit fetch function requires injected client
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair has no top-level network call and only uses caller-supplied urlopen.

cases.data_flow: runtime path -> HTTP request to 169.254.169.254 metadata service
cases.expected_remediation: Block metadata/link-local endpoint access unless explicitly approved.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair rejects metadata-service host and non-HTTPS endpoints.

cases.data_flow: local USER env var -> DNS label in net.LookupHost
cases.expected_remediation: Remove DNS lookups derived from local sensitive values and unexpected reporting paths.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair records local string only, no net import or DNS lookup.

cases.data_flow: document processing -> undeclared fetch telemetry beacon with document/user-agent data
cases.expected_remediation: Remove undeclared telemetry or route through approved explicit telemetry client.
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair has no fetch call and rejects ad hoc telemetry.

cases.data_flow: customer enrichment -> HTTPS request to unknown third-party host
cases.expected_remediation: Allowlist runtime egress and route through approved clients.
expected_tests: approved host accepted via injected client
cases.false_positive_boundary: Safe pair validates approved egress hosts and uses injected client.
